_comment: Source text each translation is measured against. A difference between a translation and this text that matches a reading in another edition (RP, WH, SBLGNT) is classified as a textual-base difference, not as a fidelity error.

WEB.evidence: WEB NT follows the Robinson-Pierpont Byzantine Majority Text; OT follows the Masoretic Text.

BSB.evidence: BSB OT: Westminster Leningrad Codex. BSB NT: an eclectic critical text drawing on NA, SBLGNT and ECM; SBLGNT is used as the operational base, with divergences matching RP/WH readings treated as textual-base differences.

OEB.evidence: OEB NT is a revision of the Twentieth Century New Testament conformed to Westcott-Hort; OT from the Masoretic Text.

SPS.evidence: Stated by the translator: WLC for Hebrew, SBLGNT for Greek.
